scope: Seven Export Policy Order amendments not present in the accepted regulatory retrieval corpus. SRO 2486(I)/2025 is excluded from this list because its raw-cotton terms were manually validated and are already active.
searches_performed: all normalized eight-digit supported PCT codes, with and without a dot
all supported six-digit subheadings and four-digit parent headings
configured product names and material/category terms
destination, route, licence, permit, prohibition, restriction, duty drawback, Certificate of Origin, Form-E, SBP and effective-date terms
schedule, appendix and paragraph references against the Export Policy Order predecessor text
structured amendment affected-code arrays and unresolved-source-conflict records

amendments.title: Further amendment to the Export Policy Order, 2022 — Angoor Adda export land route
amendments.source_authority: Government of Pakistan, Ministry of Commerce
amendments.extraction_method: Tesseract OCR with searchable-PDF and validated-text derivatives
amendments.ocr_status: success; no page was flagged for material OCR review
amendments.validation_status: operative page remains OCR_verified, not manually verified
amendments.blocked_reason: The amendment is outside the accepted source registry and the amendment dataset remains blocked for legal execution pending legal review; the operative page was not in the manual visual-validation set.
amendments.likely_textile_relevance: Conditional operational relevance: paragraph 7 expressly covers exports to Afghanistan and through Afghanistan, while the predecessor paragraph includes textile and textile articles.

evidence_pages.evidence: Adds Angoor Adda to paragraph 7(5)'s authorized export land routes.
Paragraph 7(1) includes textile and textile articles.

amendments.impact_confidence: high for route-only scope; high that no configured CACE rule is changed
amendments.action_note: CACE has no route-clearance verdict or route input. The amendment adds an allowed route and does not change a configured document, destination, PCT, licensing or duty-drawback rule. The existing Afghanistan yarn rule is independently manual_review under paragraph 7(3).

amendments.title: Further amendments to the Export Policy Order, 2022 — paragraph 7 and vegetable-ghee conditions
amendments.source_authority: Government of Pakistan, Ministry of Commerce
amendments.predecessor: SRO 544(I)/2022, paragraph 7(6)-(7) and Schedule II serial 8
amendments.extraction_method: Tesseract OCR followed by line-by-line manual validation
amendments.ocr_status: success with a restored phrase that OCR omitted
amendments.validation_status: manually_verified page; amendment dataset still not approved for legal execution
amendments.blocked_reason: The amendment is not an accepted indexed source and the consolidated amendment dataset remains blocked pending legal review and unresolved conflicts elsewhere in the chain.
amendments.likely_textile_relevance: Paragraph 7(6)-(7) could concern supported textiles only for exports from an Export Processing Zone, manufacturing bond or export-oriented unit, or to the named Afghanistan agencies. The Schedule II change is solely vegetable ghee/cooking oil.

evidence_pages.evidence: Omits paragraph 7(6)-(7); separately amends Schedule II serial 8.
Paragraph 7(6)-(7) concerns special exporter regimes and Afghanistan agencies.
Schedule II serial 8 contains PCT 1516.1000, 1516.2010, 1516.2020 and 1518.0000, not supported textile PCTs.

amendments.impact_confidence: high that special-regime benefits may be relevant operationally; high that no configured CACE rule is changed
amendments.action_note: CACE does not decide EPZ/manufacturing-bond/EU benefit entitlement. The configured yarn-to-Afghanistan manual-review rule relies on paragraph 7(3) and Schedule III item 3, neither of which is amended.

amendments.title: Further amendments to the Export Policy Order, 2022 — PCT transpositions
amendments.source_authority: Government of Pakistan, Ministry of Commerce
amendments.predecessor: SRO 544(I)/2022, Schedule I and Appendices A, B, C, G, H and J
amendments.extraction_method: Tesseract OCR; pages 1, 2 and 6 manually compared with page images
amendments.ocr_status: success with review; OCR defects were found and preserved separately
amendments.validation_status: mixed manually_verified/OCR_verified with two unresolved printed-code conflicts
amendments.blocked_reason: The intended code on page 2 and one code in the page 6 sequence cannot be corrected without an authoritative corrigendum; the dataset explicitly blocks legal execution.
amendments.likely_textile_relevance: No direct textile Chapter 50-63 code, parent heading or configured product description occurs. The Appendix-J transpositions are food and wood entries.

evidence_pages.evidence: All printed old/new codes and descriptions were searched; none falls in Chapters 50-63 or a supported parent heading.

amendments.action_note: The unresolved values are in Chapters 23/29 and 44, outside all supported PCT headings. Neither value was normalized or guessed.

amendments.title: Further amendment to the Export Policy Order, 2022 — Appendix G hides, skins and leather omissions
amendments.source_authority: Government of Pakistan, Ministry of Commerce
amendments.extraction_method: Tesseract OCR followed by manual validation of the amendment page; predecessor codes resolved from base-order pages 40-42
amendments.validation_status: amendment page manually_verified; predecessor code resolution OCR_verified
amendments.blocked_reason: The amendment is outside the accepted source registry and the consolidated chain remains blocked pending legal review.
amendments.likely_textile_relevance: None for CACE's textile catalog; the affected headings are hides, skins, leather and leather waste in Chapter 41.

evidence_pages.evidence: Omits the specified Appendix G serial ranges.
The serial ranges resolve to Chapter 41 leather/hide codes.

amendments.action_note: Leather is outside the configured categories and none of the affected headings falls in Chapters 50-63.

amendments.title: Further amendments to the Export Policy Order, 2022 — donkey hides
amendments.source_authority: Government of Pakistan, Ministry of Commerce
amendments.predecessor: SRO 544(I)/2022, Schedule I and Appendix G serial 170
amendments.extraction_method: Tesseract OCR with searchable-PDF and validated-text derivatives
amendments.ocr_status: success; no material OCR defect flagged
amendments.validation_status: OCR_verified only; 'respective headings' resolved to predecessor PCT 4101.5090
amendments.blocked_reason: The page was not manually legally validated, uses the broad phrase 'respective headings', and is not in the accepted source registry.
amendments.likely_textile_relevance: None; both the new condition and predecessor entry concern donkey hides in Chapter 41.

evidence_pages.evidence: Adds a donkey-hide condition under respective headings and removes the old Appendix G note.
Appendix G serial 170 resolves to PCT 4101.5090.

amendments.action_note: The broad heading was resolved through the predecessor rather than treated as no-impact merely because no eight-digit code was printed.

conclusion.reason: Two amendments have conditional operational relevance to special Afghanistan routes or exporter regimes, but neither changes a field or rule CACE decides. The remaining five are outside the supported textile chapters. Adding a blanket manual-review condition would change unaffected shipment outcomes without a validated rule trigger.
